up: Retrieve the exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_type) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1741324. Only include measurements where the relation is '=' (exact values). For each entry, provide the compound identifier (molecule_chembl_id) and the activity details. Do not filter by activity type or other criteria.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741324' AND a.standard_relation = '=';
